skill.name: django-pro
skill.description: Master Django 5.x with async views, DRF, Celery, and Django Channels. Build scalable web applications with proper architecture, testing, and deployment.
skill.summary: Guide Django 5.x architecture, APIs, async work, testing, performance, and deployment.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a resource path. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable payload was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text is an inline Markdown file reference, not a Ruby or shell execution context. SKILL.md is prompt-only and contains no executable script or command interpolation.

content.value_statement: Django projects can become slow, fragile, or hard to deploy without clear architecture. This skill guides Django 5.x design, APIs, tests, performance, and release practices.
actual_capabilities: Designs Django 5.x project structures for reusable apps and maintainable settings.
Recommends ORM optimizations using relationships, indexes, annotations, and eager loading.
Guides DRF API design, authentication, permissions, serializers, and tests.
Plans async views, Django Channels, Celery workers, and cache-backed workflows.
Reviews deployment concerns for Docker, ASGI, static files, environment variables, and CI.
Highlights Django security practices for CSRF, CORS, XSS, SQL injection, and permissions.
limitations: It does not run, inspect, or validate a live Django environment by itself.
It cannot replace project-specific load testing, security review, or production monitoring.
It may need current dependency versions and settings before giving precise deployment advice.
It should not be used for non-Django backend frameworks.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Django Service
use_cases.description: Create a clear app layout, settings strategy, data model, and testing plan before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Improve API Reliability
use_cases.description: Review DRF endpoints, authentication, permissions, serializers, and database access for maintainable production behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Production Launch
use_cases.description: Check caching, background tasks, ASGI deployment, static files, environment variables, and observability before release.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Project Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Django app idea. Suggest models, app boundaries, admin setup, tests, and a simple deployment path.

prompt_templates.title: API Design Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Building a Django REST Framework API
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my DRF API design. Check serializers, permissions, authentication, pagination, error handling, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Performance Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Django performance problem. Identify likely ORM issues, caching options, indexes, async boundaries, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Enterprise Architecture Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scalable Django 5.x architecture for this product. Include app structure, data flows, Celery, Channels, deployment, security, and migration risks.

output_examples.input: Optimize a queryset that repeatedly loads related author and category records.
output: Identifies an N+1 query risk in related object access.
Recommends eager loading for single and multi-value relationships.
Suggests adding tests that count queries for the target view.
Adds index and pagination checks before production rollout.

output_examples.input: Design authentication for a DRF API used by a web app and mobile clients.
output: Compares session, token, JWT, and OAuth2 approaches for the client mix.
Defines permission boundaries for user, staff, and service accounts.
Includes refresh handling, logout behavior, CSRF considerations, and audit logging.
Lists tests for expired credentials, object access, and error responses.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Django app with WebSockets and background jobs for launch.
output: Separates HTTP, ASGI, worker, scheduler, broker, and cache responsibilities.
Calls out connection limits, retry policies, and idempotent task design.
Recommends health checks, structured logs, metrics, and release rollback steps.

best_practices: Provide models, views, settings, and deployment constraints with each request.
Ask for tests and verification steps whenever the answer changes application behavior.
Confirm database size, traffic patterns, and dependency versions before applying performance advice.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for production secrets, full environment files, or private credentials.
Do not apply architecture advice without matching it to your team size and deployment model.
Do not treat generated code as complete until tests, migrations, and security checks pass.

faq.question: What Django version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Django 5.x and modern Python 3.11 or newer development patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with Django REST Framework?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers serializers, viewsets, permissions, authentication, testing, pagination, and API design tradeoffs.

faq.question: Does it support async Django work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide async views, ASGI deployment, Channels, and boundaries between sync and async code.

faq.question: Can it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It can highlight Django security practices, but production systems still need project-specific review and testing.

faq.question: Can it write deployment plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline Docker, ASGI, static files, environment settings, workers, caching, and CI checks.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best answers?
faq.answer: Share the goal, Django version, database, deployment target, traffic expectations, and any relevant code or error details.
